rules: bind the exact 46-member retained CCEL ThML/XML source cohort and source-member-set digest
account every retained member with include or exclude disposition; no retained member is silently skipped
account every retained source element, source attribute, direct text, tail text, parent selector, and child ordinal
exclude only the declared formatting-only tags style, selector, property, colgroup, and col and account their exact counts
account retained comments, processing instructions, and doctype declarations as non-TEI lexical events
preserve the non-formatting source text stream and source element selector order in TEI
validate source accountability JSON against the ticket-local schema and candidate TEI against TEI P5
independently reread retained source bytes and compare candidate accountability, mapped selectors, and text stream
reject generated data as source authority and retain the SWORD package only as a comparison witness
fresh-process and different-CWD candidate bytes must be deterministic
technical candidate evidence does not imply human acceptance, rights clearance, canonical IR, or publication
